judgment.rationale: The symptom is not distinct from the canonical open Dock issue: display detection and per-display enablement work, the Dock bar appears, and configured contents are missing only on secondary displays.
evidence: The report describes three monitors, working per-display toggles, a populated primary Dock, and empty secondary Dock bars.
Automated triage also identified issue 49604 as a likely duplicate.
Issue 49604 reports the same blank secondary-display Dock and includes a maintainer hypothesis that secondary Dock state may be initialized incorrectly.
Related issues 48466 and 48516 concern other multi-monitor Dock positioning/display-change behavior rather than this empty-content symptom.
judgment.recommended_action: Keep this as duplicate/handled by issue 49604 and, if a maintainer wants to comment, use plain issue-number wording rather than creating an automatic upstream cross-reference.

issue_context.summary: Command Palette creates a Dock bar on each enabled secondary display, but only the primary display renders the configured Dock items.
known_information: The report covers PowerToys 0.101.2362.0 installed through WinGet on a three-monitor system.
All displays are detected and their Dock enable switches work.
Issue 49604 reports the same blank secondary-display Dock and already has maintainer investigation.
inferences: This likely shares issue 49604's secondary-Dock state or band-initialization path, but no root cause is confirmed.
issue_context.analysis: The distinguishing symptoms are identical to issue 49604, including a visible bar, working monitor selection, and absent configured contents. A second implementation effort would fragment evidence without adding a distinct failure mode.
initial_investigation: Reviewed the complete report, automated triage comment, labels, assignees, project items, and timeline cross-references.
Reviewed issue 49604, including the maintainer comment that secondary Dock state may be initialized wrong and that only some related Dock reports are duplicates.
Duplicate search also found 49018 as another open Dock-on-non-primary report, but issue 49604 remains the closest canonical technical thread.
